MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 19
   C. 9
   D. 11

2. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 1

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 41
   D. 43

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 56
   D. 1

11. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 8

12. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

14. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

15. Solve for x: x + 4 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 7
   D. 11

16. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 41

17. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

20. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 3/4

21. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

22. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 2

23. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 169
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 26

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
